title: Scalar extension of module-valued sheaves
statement: For a ring k, a topological space X, a ring sheaf R on X and alpha:k -> R(X), define a functor from ModuleCat k-valued sheaves on X to R-module sheaves. It is the composite of inclusion into presheaves, conversion to constant-ring modules [def-sc-module-presheaf-constant-modules], the presheaf pullback specified by [lem-sc-field-scalar-presheaf-pullback-exists] for the structural map [def-sc-field-scalar-presheaf-ring-map], and module sheafification. Module carriers are in Type(max u v). Sheafification and its local-bijectivity characterization in that universe are obtained using filtered-colimit universe shrinking and transport to an enlarged small model of the site. The chosen pullback is determined by its adjunction up to unique natural isomorphism.
